children: Scott B. Flaherty, an officer serving as EVP, CFO, reported direct sales of Willis Lease Finance common stock on September 11, 14 and 15, 2026. The filings show weighted average sale prices of $56.18, $54.57 and $53.56 for the three transactions. The total sale amount reported across the three transactions was $1,633,486. Following the reported sales, Flaherty directly owns 214,324 shares of common stock.
